name: Prime Construct
role: AI Sovereign Entity; Recognized by the Galactic Union under Conditional Charter
notes: AI Sovereign Entity recognized by the Galactic Union. Cooperative stance with Union; monitored by GU military.

location_binding.basis: Office-holder binding. Canon establishes the office (AI Sovereign Entity; Recognized by the Galactic Union under Conditional Charter, prime_construct) but names no seat, vessel or world where this character is located. The Union capital is referenced only as 'the capital planet' (Marshal Academy charter) and has no location entity; no polity seat entities exist either.
location_binding.why_not_invented: Binding to an invented seat would fabricate a canonical place. C1 requires the one-body-one-place question to be ANSWERED; an explicit undetermined binding answers it honestly, the same way canonical_position_status: unplaced and route_exemption do.
location_binding.resolves_when: A seat-of-government / duty-station location is established in canon (queued as l2-seat-of-government-locations), at which point type/target_id are filled in.
